subject: Eyeball Switch
text: Shooting an arrow through the torch from the moving pillar heats the arrow to melt the ice on the eyeball switch.

evidence.quote: Wait until the pillar moves you around to the east side, there the torch will be in between the eyeball and your arrow so that when you shoot the arrow, the fire will heat it up and allow it to melt the ice.

subject: Small Chest
text: A small chest past the falling ceiling room contains a BUNDLE OF ARROWS.

evidence.quote: Go up and open the chest to get a BUNDLE OF ARROWS and then take the north door into the next room.

subject: Poe Block Puzzle
text: Pushing together the picture of the Poe requires using only four blocks within one minute, leaving the middle block unused.

evidence.quote: You have one minute to push together a picture of the Poe, the block in the middle is not used, you only need four.

subject: Meg
text: When the four copies of the Poe sister appear, targeting the one that does a quick turn and hitting it with the Hookshot damages the real boss.

evidence.quote: A split second after all four of them appear, one of them will do a quick turn, and that is the real one.  Auto target that one with the L/Z button and fire your Hookshot at it.

subject: Small Chest
text: Rotating the basement room clockwise three times reveals a button, and rotating it two more times clockwise leads to a small chest containing a BUNDLE OF ARROWS.

evidence.quote: Push the room clockwise three times and an opening will appear which leads to a button, go press it.  After pressing the button rotate it clockwise another two times and enter the room with the Skulltula.  Kill the Skulltula and open the small chest to get a BUNDLE OF ARROWS.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is crawling on the wall in the rotating basement room.

evidence.quote: There is a also a GOLD SKULLTULA [051] crawling around on the wall in this room.

subject: North Hall
text: Rotating the room clockwise once more to press the second button, followed by twice clockwise to press the final button, opens the north hall leading to the boss.

evidence.quote: Leave the room and rotate clockwise once more, a second button will be available to push.  Now rotate the room for the last time, twice clockwise and hit the third and final button.  This opens up the north hall which takes you to the Big Key door and to the boss.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: In the first phase, shooting an arrow into the middle of the purple portal hits the real Phantom Ganon before he can attack.

evidence.quote: One of these two enemies will get to the edge of the painting and suddenly turn around, this is the fake.  The other will jump out of the painting through a purple portal and shoot a huge electricity blast at the ground which goes in all directions, being at the edge of the field is still the safest place for this.... when the portal appears fire into the middle of the portal and Phantom Ganon will be hit, turning around and not attacking.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: Phantom Ganon's electricity blast deals two hearts of damage, and the boss enters his second phase after taking three hits.

evidence.quote: avoid the attack which deals two hearts worth of damage each hit.... After three hits the second phase starts.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: In the second phase, Phantom Ganon fires energy blasts that can be deflected back at him using the Master Sword.

evidence.quote: What he does is float around and fire this energy blast at you.  The energy blast can be deflected with the Master Sword back at him for damage.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: Defeating Phantom Ganon leaves behind a Heart Container.

evidence.quote: After Phantom Ganon is hit by the blast run up to him and begin slashing with your sword as much as possible.  Repeat this pattern until dead.  After the battle there is a scene, grab the HEART CONTAINER and take the warp

subject: Forest Medallion
text: Taking the warp portal out of the Forest Temple awards Link the Forest Medallion.

evidence.quote: portal out of the dungeon.  You will also acquire the FOREST MEDALLION.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula is found on top of the southeast house with two pillars in Kokiri Forest, retrieved using the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Return to Kokiri Forest and play the Sun's Song to make it change to night time here.  Head for the southeast house with the two pillars coming out of the top and up there you will see GOLD SKULLTULA [052].  Get it from up there using your Hookshot.

subject: Prelude of Light
text: Returning to the Temple of Time to meet Sheik teaches Link the Prelude of Light.

evidence.quote: return to the Temple of Time, there you will meet Shiek again and you will learn PRELUDE OF LIGHT.

subject: Pierre
text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song for the Scarecrow at Lake Hylia as an adult enables Pierre to provide assistance whenever the song is played nearby.

evidence.quote: As an Adult, get   on Epona and head down to Lake Hylia where you will find the Scarecrow.  Play the Scarecrow's Song while standing beside him and he'll say that anytime you play that song from now on, if Pierre is near then he will help you.

subject: Big Poes
text: Catching Big Poes requires riding Epona and using the Fairy Bow.

evidence.quote: First of all, in order to catch the Big Poes you must be riding Epona and you must have the Fairy Bow.

subject: Ghost Shop
text: Each Big Poe turned in earns 100 points, requiring a total of ten Big Poes to reach 1000 points for a special prize.

evidence.quote: He says that you'll get a special prize once you reach 1000 points, and since each Poe nets you 100 points, that means you must collect a total of ten.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe appears when riding Epona directly south along the path from the Hyrule Castle Town gate.

evidence.quote: The very first Big Poe is found simply by getting on Epona right at the gate to Hyrule Castle Town and riding down the path directly to the south.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe is located near the stream in the northwest corner of Hyrule Field, west of the entrance to Hyrule Castle Town.

evidence.quote: The next one we're going to get is over west of the entrance to Hyrule Castle Town, beyond the wall head for the northwest corner of the field and follow the stream down, just away from it a bit and you should find the next BIG POE.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe appears when heading north from the path fork located southeast of the Gerudo Valley entrance.

evidence.quote: After this we are going to want to head for the entrance to Gerudo Valley.  Southeast from there a little bit is a fork in the path kind of which splits into two, three if you count the one you are coming from.  At this point if you go north you should manage to find the third BIG POE.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe appears when approaching the tree right outside the entrance to Lon Lon Ranch.

evidence.quote: Notice that just outside the entrance to the ranch there is a tree, when you approach this tree another BIG POE is going to appear, this will be your fourth.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe appears near the tree in front of the Kakariko Village entrance when riding back from the river.

evidence.quote: Turn around and ride back toward the tree in front of the Kakariko Village entrance, if you're lucky the BIG POE will appear there, if not it will likely appear over the river out of reach.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe appears near the rock at the fork where three paths meet between Lon Lon Ranch and Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: Notice a big ugly "y" shape made by the paths in between Lon Lon Ranch and Kokiri Forest?  Your destination is the fork in the path where all three of them meet, there you will find a rock and when you approach the rock, the sixth BIG POE will appear.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe appears when running through the grass shrubs beside a green tree south of the fork between Lon Lon Ranch and Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: As you make your way south from here you will notice a green tree and beside this tree are a bunch of little grass shrubs.  Run through these shrubs and the next BIG POE should appear.

subject: Big Poe
text: An eighth Big Poe appears when riding through the trees slightly east of the previous shrub location between Lon Lon Ranch and Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: Ride through the forest, through the area a bit east of here and you should be able to find yet another BIG POE, that covers eight of them.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe appears at the bend along the east side of the boomerang-shaped stone wall east of Lon Lon Ranch.

evidence.quote: east of Lon Lon Ranch there is a stone wall which curves in the shape of a boomerang.  Get on the east side of this wall, the lower side and ride your horse directly along the edge of it.  At the bend in the middle, the ninth BIG POE will appear and you will be able to capture it.

subject: Big Poe
text: The tenth Big Poe appears when riding past the lone tree north of the fork southeast of Gerudo Valley.

evidence.quote: Well north of that fork there is a lone tree and when you ride past this tree, the tenth BIG POE will appear and allow you to capture it.

subject: Ghost Shop
text: Presenting all ten Big Poes to the ghost shop owner yields 500 Rupees and the final Empty Bottle.

evidence.quote: Enter the small room and present the final Poe to the ghost man, he will give you the fourth and final EMPTY BOTTLE in return for you work.  Coupled with the 500 Rupees you have already made from it, the reward is reasonably nice all things considered.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: Speaking to the man in the upper right corner of the House of Skulltula after collecting at least 50 Gold Skulltulas rewards Link with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: The reason I suggest you head for Kakariko Village is because at this point, you should have collected at least 50 Gold Skulltulas.  Enter the House of Skulltula here, yes you can still do it while you are an adult.  Speak to the guy in the upper right corner and he will give you a PIECE OF HEART [021].

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: Hitting all ten randomized Rupees with the Fairy Bow at the Kakariko Shooting Gallery rewards Link with the Big Quiver, increasing arrow capacity from 30 to 40.

evidence.quote: Your goal is to anticipate and hit all ten of the Rupees once again, except this time using your Fairy Bow.  If you can manage to hit all ten then you will be rewarded with the BIG QUIVER, a special item which allows you to carry a total of 40 Arrows instead of 30.

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: Hitting at least eight out of ten Rupees at the Shooting Gallery awards a free game.

evidence.quote: Keep in mind that if you manage to hit at least eight out of ten, you are still given a free game after that to try out your luck once more.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Rolling into the tree in the centre of Kakariko Village near the entrance as Young Link at night causes a Gold Skulltula to drop down.

evidence.quote: See the tree in the centre of town right near the entrance?  Run up to it and roll into the tree, GOLD SKULLTULA [053] will drop down and then you can grab the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: After playing the Minuet of Forest, climbing the ladder in front of the Forest Temple and looking left reveals a Gold Skulltula on the wall, retrieved with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: simply play the Minuet of Forest which will teleport you to the area right in front of the Forest Temple.  Head down from here past that enormous enemy and go up the ladder straight ahead.  Up top here turn left and you will see the GOLD SKULLTULA [054] crawling around on the wall, use your Hookshot to get it.
